question: What clinical entity is caused, mainly, by Clostridium difficile ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Clostridium difficile infection -> release of toxins -> damage to the intestinal lining -> inflammation -> diarrhea associated with antibiotics -> 95% CHAIN: Clostridium difficile infection -> overgrowth of bacteria -> disruption of normal gut flora -> diarrhea associated with antibiotics -> 95%
enhanced_information: Clostridium difficile infection mainly causes diarrhea associated with antibiotics by overgrowth of bacteria leading to disruption of normal gut flora, resulting in damage to the intestinal lining and inflammation.
analysis: Clostridium difficile infection mainly causes diarrhea associated with antibiotics by disrupting the normal gut flora and leading to intestinal damage and inflammation. This is a well-established clinical entity associated with this bacterium.
